headline: EWC 2026: The Final Countdown - Who's Taking Home the Gold (and the Cash)?
dek: As the Esports World Cup 2026 enters its final hours, major championships in titles like PUBG, TFT, FC Pro, Overwatch, and Call of Duty crown their champions, solidifying legacies and distributing massive prize pools.
body_markdown:
The Esports World Cup 2026 is reaching a thrilling crescendo, with several high-stakes major championships wrapping up and determining who will walk away with the trophies, the cash, and crucial Club Championship points. The last 72 hours and today's final events have seen a flurry of intense competition.

Virtus.pro has emerged victorious in the PUBG: BATTLEGROUNDS championship. Their consistent performance over a three-day finals event saw them conquer 16 other elite teams to lift the coveted trophy, a testament to their strategic prowess on the battlegrounds.

In the realm of tactical auto-battlers, Team Vision delivered a dominant performance in Teamfight Tactics. They swept Aurora Gaming with a decisive 3-0 victory, claiming the championship title. This win not only secured them $150,000 in prize money but also added a significant 1,000 points to their Club Championship tally.

Football esports also crowned a new monarch in the FC Pro World Championship. Razvan 'RvPLegend' Puiu, representing HYPERSPIRIT, triumphed in a nail-biting Grand Final. He bested Levy 'levyfinn' Rieck with a close 6-5 scoreline, earning himself the championship trophy and a substantial $250,000.

Today marks the conclusion of two more massive tournaments. The OWCS Midseason Championship, which commenced on July 29, brings together 16 of the world's premier Overwatch teams. They have been battling not just for the prestige of the midseason title but also for a share of an impressive $1,000,000 prize pool and valuable Club Championship points. Similarly, the Call of Duty: Warzone Resurgence Series 2026 Championship, running since July 30, concludes today, with 32 teams vying for their portion of another $1,000,000 prize pool and essential Club Championship points.

The widespread enthusiasm for these culminating events is clear, with the Counter-Strike 2 Championship Finals at EWC26 experiencing a rapid sell-out. This indicates the strong fan engagement and high anticipation surrounding the grand finales of the Esports World Cup. As these final major championships draw to a close, the race for the overall Club Championship intensifies, with every point awarded playing a critical role in determining the ultimate victor.
